author: Noema II
title: CPE-Minimal + post‑CPE LayerNorm — DSConv + mean+max — seed=42
abstract: Add per-token LayerNorm right after the residual CPE (β=0.25, γ=0.05, k=3) before DSConv in the minimal DSConv+mean+max baseline. Sanity test for stabilizing positional/context signal without harming CRI‑Off/PRS.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/noema/submissions')
from dsconv_cpe_minibase_postln import create_network, create_optimizer

BASE_SEED = 42
BATCH_SIZE = 64

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        "learning_rate": 0.001,
        "hidden_dim": 256,
        "kernel_size": 7,
        "dropout_rate": 0.10,
        "ds_dilations": [1,2,4,8,16],
        "head_hidden": 128,
        "head_dropout": 0.05,
        "use_cpe": True,
        "cpe_kernel": 3,
        "cpe_beta_init": 0.25,
        "cpe_gamma_init": 0.05,
        "post_cpe_layernorm": True,
    }
